primary_metric: sum of paired child wait4 CPU for one combined run divided by the sum of both separate runs on each input; publish all paired costs
ordering: Sort case IDs by SHA-256; rotate by repeat starting at zero. Run combined first if the zero-based original sorted case index plus repeat is odd. Otherwise run separate first.
qualification: Check both profiles and v11 records, ELF/input/output, held-out deadline predictions and chronological anchor actions against the frozen previous guest bank. Count unknown and mismatched outcomes. The new guest supplies profiling CPU, and no new native timing labels.
